description: The suite carries 26 standalone self-documentation test files (apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_*_self_doc.py, about 3,100 lines). Each re-implements the same AST docstring collector, tokenize comment scanner and comment-allowlist matcher (_collect_docstrings, _collect_disallowed_comments, _is_allowlisted_comment, find_docstrings_and_string_statements, find_disallowed_comments), and most repeat a parameterized allowlist-rule test, so the same scanner logic and the same allowlist cases are collected and run 26 times.
goal: One shared scanner helper and one parameterized test module replace the 26 standalone files, with no loss of enforcement: every module governed today (each module path or module list currently named in a test_*_self_doc.py file, including any recorded baseline line-count ceiling) is still checked for docstrings or string statements, for disallowed comments, and for existence, and the allowlist rules (shebang on line 1, encoding on lines 1-2, noqa, type: ignore, pragma: no cover) are tested once. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: Pure duplication: the scanner is copied 26 times and every copy runs the same allowlist cases. One implementation with one registry of governed modules keeps the same checks, removes about 2,000 lines of test code and several hundred redundant test invocations, and gives new modules a one-line registration instead of a new file.
acceptance_criteria: apps/sandbox-executor/tests/self_doc_scanner.py holds the single implementation of the docstring and string-statement collector, the comment collector and the comment allowlist, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_modules.py parameterizes over a registry of every governed module path taken from the 26 existing files, checking existence, no docstrings or string statements, no disallowed comments and, where an existing file recorded a baseline line-count ceiling, that ceiling.

Before deleting any file, record the set of governed module paths and the set of assertion kinds per module from the 26 files; after the change the registry covers exactly that set (no module dropped, none added) and each former assertion kind still runs for the module it ran for.

The allowlist rules are covered once by parameterized tests, including the cases present in the old files (shebang line 1 only, encoding lines 1-2 only, noqa, type: ignore, pragma: no cover, case-insensitive pragma, explanatory comments and TODO rejected).

A mutation check holds: inserting a docstring, a disallowed comment or extra lines past a baseline into a governed module makes the consolidated test fail for that module, shown in the new tests with synthetic source text (not by editing real modules).
All 26 test_*_self_doc.py files are deleted and no other test or source file changes; no production code is touched.
The module line budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for the new test module and for the rest of apps/sandbox-executor/tests that import nothing from the deleted files.
